title: Waste of time
body:
This app goes through a whole process of getting you motivated, building something that could genuinely be worth while, but only if you pay an overpriced subscription. It gets your hopes up that maybe something will happen, maybe this will give me structure then forces a free trial down your throat. I have tried many apps like this and for a second I thought that maybe this would be different. How evil is it to offer hope then capitalise off of someone who’s lost and battling? 

Why not offer important features for free, and keep donations open or other less important but nice features behind a paywall? Hell, run ads if you have to, I don’t care. How can Notion run COMPLETELY free and have such a huge fan base, but still be worth millions of dollars? If you wanna make money, be different and build a fan base not based on your own greed. 

Waste of my energy, time and even made my already bad day even worse
